decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - INFORMATIVE: This certificate is issued on the basis that the proposed use of the property as a children's home for up to 2 children and 4 carers (on a rota basis) living together (not more than 2 children, day manager and 3 rota carers in total), would fall within the C2 Use Class (Residential Institution) and although, a change of use from Use Class C3 to Use Class C2 would take place, on the basis of the information provided, it does not amount to a material change of use and no 'development' requiring planning permission would take place. 
Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE: This certificate is based on the documents and any other information as submitted being a true reflection of the proposed circumstances intended on site. If the existing or proposed conditions are different from those shown on the drawings/documents or if the drawings or any other information are inaccurate in any way, the certificate may not be valid.
Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE: This certificate is issued solely for the purpose of Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). 

It certifies that the use/operations described in the Planning Statement by SW Town Planning Limited. would have been lawful, on the certified date and, thus, was/were not liable to enforcement action, under section 172 of the 1990 Act, on that date.

This certificate applies only to the extent of the use/operations described in the Planning Statement. Any use/operation which is materially different from that described, or which relates to any other land, may result in a breach of planning control which is liable to enforcement action by the local planning authority.

The effect of the certificate is subject to the provisions in section 192(4) of the 1990 Act, as amended, which state that the lawfulness of a specified use or operation is only conclusively presumed where there has been no material change, before the use is instituted or the operations begun, in any of the matters which were relevant to the decision about lawfulness.
description: Change of use from a single dwelling (Class C3a) to a residential children's home (Class C2) for up to two children.
